stories.title: Convicted rapist who abused wife was 'master manipulator'
stories.summary: Joanne Donald said her husband abused her "hundreds of times" over a nine-year period.

stories.title: Linfield travel to Ballymena in BetMcLean Cup
stories.summary: Holders Linfield will travel to Ballymena United in the quarter-finals of the BetMcLean Cup.

stories.title: Strabane withdraws from UK Town of Culture bid due to 'great division'
stories.summary: The County Tyrone town was shortlisted as one of 15 possible locations for the inaugural UK Town of Culture 2028, with the chance to win £3m.

stories.title: University 'looking into' street party near campus
stories.summary: Police and community safety wardens responded to reports of a large party close to the university campus in Derry.

stories.title: Jason Arday research for Queen's University cleared in investigation
stories.summary: The 41-year-old was found dead in August following weeks of media coverage over plagiarism allegations and questions about his achievements, which he denied.

stories.title: Students vote to retain university campus' historic name
stories.summary: Magee: The campus is named after Martha Magee, who bequeathed a sum of money in the mid-1800s to establish a theological college in Derry.

stories.title: Gales cancel evening ferry sailings
stories.summary: The evening sailing of the Ben-my-Chree to Larne and its overnight return are cancelled.

stories.title: Irish runner Beggs wins award for Boston fair play
stories.summary: Northern Ireland's Aaron Beggs is one of two runners awarded the International Fair Play award after they stepped in to help a fellow competitor cross the finish line at the Boston Marathon.

stories.title: State and police apologies must be backed by action, Finucane inquiry told
stories.summary: Finucane, 39, was shot by the Ulster Defence Association (UDA) at home in front of his wife and children in 1989.

stories.title: Chloe Mitchell killer had prior paranoid schizophrenia diagnosis, court told
stories.summary: Brandon Rainey denies a charge of murder and a charge of preventing the lawful burial of Chloe Mitchell's remains.

stories.title: Air ambulance dispatched to Belfast docks after vehicle overturns
stories.summary: An ambulance and an air ambulance were tasked to the scene after reports of an incident at 09:42 BST on Thursday.

stories.title: Roof of factory partially collapses in major fire
stories.summary: Firefighters say they faced difficult conditions as the "very intense" fire on the Greystone Road.
